method: Aer noise-model prediction, computed and committed BEFORE registration
why_not_calibrated: No IBM token was configured when the threshold was derived, so a generic superconducting model stands in. Generic and stated is honest; a threshold tuned to the device after seeing its calibration would not be.
threshold_rule: min(0.25, 2 * worst predicted TVD + 0.05). Doubling absorbs the gap between a generic model and a real device; the cap keeps a pathological prediction from setting a threshold nothing could fail.
